description: Exide Magic 875VA 12V home inverter gives steady power backup for Indian homes during power cuts, low voltage, and daily fluctuations. This 875VA modified square wave inverter comfortably supports essentials like ceiling fans, LED lights, Wi‑Fi router, set‑top box and TV, so your rooms stay bright and connected when the grid drops. Its wide 100V–290V AC input range keeps charging and backup stable even in problem areas. Dual Stage Intelligent ASIC charging helps your 12V inverter battery charge faster, run cooler, and last longer. Get a regulated 235V ± 15V output with up to 95% efficiency, plus built‑in safety protections against overload, short circuit, AC back feed, overcharge, deep discharge and overheating. A tough metal-plastic body with soft-touch controls and a 42-month warranty make it a dependable, everyday home UPS solution (indoor, well‑ventilated installation recommended).
